@graph.name: 58 commercial task managers compared (2026) · todoi.org
@graph.description: Pricing, features and six scored criteria for commercial, closed-source task managers sold as a service, each with the reasoning attached.

item.name: Adobe Workfront
item.operatingSystem: Web; Adobe Workfront apps for iOS and Android; Workfront View for iPad.
item.description: Enterprise work management for marketing and creative operations: projects, requests, proofing, timesheets and portfolio planning, sold by quote.

item.name: Asana
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, desktop apps for macOS and Windows.
item.description: Work management for teams: tasks and projects shown as lists, boards, calendars and timelines, with portfolios, goals and AI agents on top.

offers.description: Starter, per user per month billed annually; $13.49 billed monthly. Paid plans start at 2 seats, added one at a time up to 5 users, then in steps of 5 up to 30, 10 up to 100, 25 up to 500 and 50 beyond.

item.name: Azure Boards
item.operatingSystem: Web, with Visual Studio and Excel clients; no official mobile app for Boards was found. Azure DevOps Server runs on Windows Server for self-hosting.
item.description: Work tracking inside Azure DevOps: backlogs, Kanban boards, sprints, queries and delivery plans, tied to repos and pipelines.

offers.description: Azure DevOps Basic, per user per month after the first 5 free users, billed monthly through an Azure subscription; no annual rate is published.

item.name: Google Tasks
item.operatingSystem: Web (inside Google Calendar and the side panel of Gmail, Chat, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides), Android, iOS and ChromeOS. No desktop app for Windows, macOS or Linux.
item.description: Free, minimal to-do list built into Gmail, Google Calendar and the Workspace side panel, with lists, subtasks, due dates and repeats.

offers.description: No paid tier of its own. Free with any Google account; organisations get admin control, data regions and Gemini features through Google Workspace, from Business Starter at $7 per user per month on an annual plan ($8.40 flexible).

item.name: Jira
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and Android. The official Jira Cloud for Mac app is no longer supported.
item.description: Issue and project tracker built around configurable workflows, with backlog, board, timeline, list and calendar views and a 6,000-app marketplace.

offers.description: Standard billed annually at $950 a year for the 10-user tier (about $7.92 per user per month; $9,700 for 100 users); monthly billing is $9.70 per user for users 1-100. Prices from 13 October 2026.

item.name: Microsoft Planner
item.operatingSystem: Web, Planner in Teams (Windows, macOS, Linux via the Teams client), Outlook integration, iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Microsoft 365’s task and project planner: boards and schedules in every suite, with Gantt timelines, sprints and goals from Planner Plan 1.

offers.description: Planner Plan 1, per user per month paid annually as listed by Microsoft in October 2026; basic Planner comes with most Microsoft 365 business and enterprise suites at no extra charge.

item.name: Microsoft To Do
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, Windows and macOS, plus Outlook (web, new Outlook, mobile) and Teams. No Linux app.
item.description: Free personal task list from Microsoft with My Day, smart lists and steps, stored in Exchange Online and woven into Outlook and Teams.

offers.description: No paid tier of its own. Free with any personal Microsoft account (Outlook.com, Skype, Xbox); for organisations it comes with Microsoft 365 business, enterprise and education plans that include an Exchange Online mailbox.

item.name: monday work management
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, desktop apps for macOS and Windows.
item.description: Board-and-column work management: every project is a configurable table of items shown as table, Kanban, timeline, Gantt or calendar.

offers.description: Basic, per seat per month billed annually; $12 billed monthly. Seats are sold in buckets: a 3-seat minimum, then multiples of 5, so a team of 4 buys 5 seats and a team of 6 buys 10.

item.name: Notion
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android; Notion Calendar for macOS, Windows and iOS; web clipper extensions.
item.description: Workspace of pages and databases: wikis, docs and task databases shown as table, board, timeline or calendar, with AI agents built in.

offers.description: Plus, per member per month billed annually; $12 billed monthly. Guests are free; there is no seat minimum.

item.name: Smartsheet
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android; add-ins for Outlook and Gmail.
item.description: Spreadsheet-style work management: sheets of rows with formulas and dependencies, shown as grid, Gantt, board or calendar, with dashboards on top.

offers.description: Pro, per Member per month billed annually; $12 billed monthly. Pro is limited to 10 Members and is sold only to new customers; Business ($19) requires at least 3 Members.

item.name: Trello
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, macOS and Windows desktop apps; email-to-board and Slack capture into the Inbox.
item.description: Kanban boards of lists and cards, with Power-Up add-ons; calendar, timeline and table views sit on the Premium plan.

offers.description: Standard, per user per month billed annually; $6 billed monthly.

item.name: Airtable
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS and Windows desktop apps, iOS, Android.
item.description: No-code relational database with a spreadsheet face: linked tables as grid, Kanban, calendar, timeline or Gantt, plus automations and AI.

offers.description: Team, per seat per month billed annually; $24 billed monthly. Only users with edit rights are billed; read-only collaborators are free.

item.name: Any.do
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, iPadOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Apple Watch and Wear OS, plus Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari extensions and a Gmail add-on.
item.description: Personal to-do list and daily planner with a mirrored calendar and WhatsApp reminders, plus Family and Teams boards with Kanban and Gantt views.

offers.description: Premium, per person per month billed annually; $7.99 billed monthly. Teams is also $4.99 per member per month billed annually ($7.99 monthly).

item.name: Basecamp
item.operatingSystem: Web; iOS and Android apps; desktop apps for macOS and Windows; installable PWA in Chrome (including Linux), Safari and Edge.
item.description: Project workspace for small teams and client work: to-dos, message boards, Kanban card tables, chat, docs and a calendar per project.

offers.description: Flat rate, not per user: Freelancer is $29 a month for the whole account (up to 5 users, 3 active projects), billed monthly only; annual billing exists only on Pro Unlimited ($199 a month billed annually, $329 monthly).

item.name: Bitrix24
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, and desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux.
item.description: A business suite whose tasks module offers lists, Kanban, Gantt, Scrum and time tracking beside CRM, chat and documents. Cloud or self-hosted.

offers.description: Flat rate per organisation, not per user: Basic is $49 a month billed annually ($69 monthly) for up to 5 users; Standard $99 ($144) covers 50 users and Professional $199 ($289) covers 100. No per-user plan exists.

item.name: ClickUp
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, desktop apps for macOS and Windows, Chrome extension.
item.description: Task and project workspace with a deep Space, Folder, List hierarchy, 15-plus views, docs, chat, whiteboards and metered AI agents.

offers.description: Core, per user per month billed annually; $12 billed monthly. No seat minimum; the whole Workspace must be upgraded.

item.name: TickTick
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and iPadOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, watch apps and a browser extension.
item.description: Personal task list and planner combining lists, Kanban, a timeline, calendar views, habit tracking and a Pomodoro focus timer.

offers.description: Premium, $49.99 a year per person (under $4.17 a month); $4.99 billed monthly on the web checkout and the US App Store. The price rose from $35.99 a year and $3.99 a month between July and October 2026.

item.name: Todoist
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, Apple Watch and Wear OS, plus browser extensions and email add-ons.
item.description: Personal and small-team task list built on projects, labels and filters, with natural-language dates and list, board and calendar layouts.

offers.description: Pro, per person per month billed annually ($60 a year); $7 billed monthly. Business is $8 per user per month billed annually or $10 monthly since 10 December 2025.

item.name: Wrike
item.operatingSystem: Web, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android.
item.description: Project and portfolio management for marketing, PMO and service teams: folders, projects and tasks with Gantt, workload, proofing and approvals.

offers.description: Team, per user per month billed annually, for 2 to 15 users; Wrike publishes no monthly price. Business ($25, 5 to 200 users) is sold only on annual terms; seats come in groups of 5 up to 30, 10 up to 100 and 25 above.

item.name: Zoho Projects
item.operatingSystem: Web; iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Project management inside the Zoho suite: task lists, Kanban, Gantt with dependencies, timesheets, issue tracking and workflow blueprints.

offers.description: Premium, per user per month billed annually; $5 billed monthly. No seat minimum is stated.

item.name: Coda (Superhuman Docs)
item.operatingSystem: Web; desktop and mobile apps (iOS and Android) on every plan.
item.description: Coda, now sold as Superhuman Docs: doc-and-database pages with linked tables in table, card, calendar and timeline views, formulas and Packs.

offers.description: Pro, per Doc Maker per month billed annually ($15 monthly); Editors and Viewers are free, so only people who create docs or pages are billed.

item.name: GanttPRO
item.operatingSystem: Web; iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Online Gantt chart planner with auto-scheduling, critical path and baselines, plus board, list, calendar and workload views at higher tiers.

offers.description: Core, per user per month billed annually for teams of up to 15; $7 from 20 seats; $9 billed monthly, and a single seat is sold annually only.

item.name: Hive
item.operatingSystem: Web; desktop apps for macOS and Windows; iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Work management with many project layouts (Gantt, Kanban, table, calendar, timeline), built-in chat and email, and Buzz AI credits on every plan.

offers.description: Starter, per user per month billed annually, capped at 10 members and 10 projects; the Teams plan is $12 billed annually, and the page’s own calculator implies $18 billed monthly.

item.name: Linear
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS and Windows desktop apps, iOS and Android.
item.description: Fast, keyboard-driven issue tracker for software teams, organised around teams, cycles, projects and initiatives, with coding agents built in.

offers.description: Basic, per user per month billed annually; Linear’s page shows yearly prices only, and third-party trackers report $12 billed monthly.

item.name: MeisterTask
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and Android. Windows and macOS desktop apps were discontinued on 28 April 2025. Gmail and Outlook add-ins.
item.description: Kanban task boards with a list view, built-in time tracking and a Business-tier timeline, hosted in Germany.

offers.description: Pro, per user per month billed annually; €15.50 billed monthly. Published in euros only, excluding VAT; about $14 at the November 2026 rate of $1.12 to the euro.

item.name: Motion
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS and Windows desktop apps, iOS and Android.
item.description: A task, project and calendar tool that auto-schedules work into each person’s calendar, now sold to small businesses as an AI work suite.

offers.description: Pro AI for teams, per seat per month billed annually; $29 billed monthly. A single-person Pro AI subscription costs more: $29 annually or $49 monthly.

item.name: Podio
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS (including iPad) and Android.
item.description: No-code workspace where teams build their own apps of custom fields, then track them as tables, cards and calendars with workflow rules.

offers.description: Plus, per employee per month billed annually; $14 billed monthly. Once upgraded you pay for every employee, including the first five.

item.name: ProofHub
item.operatingSystem: Web; iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Flat-priced project tool for teams and clients: task boards, Gantt, table and calendar views, time tracking, chat, discussions and file proofing.

offers.description: Flat rate for the whole account with unlimited users, not per user: Essential is $45 a month billed annually ($50 monthly) for 40 projects and 15 GB.

item.name: Remember The Milk
item.operatingSystem: Web, iPhone and iPad, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux (Ubuntu and Fedora) and Apple Watch (Pro).
item.description: Long-running personal task list built on Smart Add, tags and saved-search Smart Lists, with reminders by email, text and push.

offers.description: Pro, $49.99 a year per person (about $4.17 a month); no monthly option is listed.

item.name: Taskade
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Chrome, Firefox and Edge extensions.
item.description: Outliner-based workspace with eight project views, AI agents, automations and prompt-built apps; priced per workspace, not per seat.

offers.description: Starter, flat per workspace per month, sold on annual billing only ($72 a year) and covering up to 3 users. Pro is $10 a month annually ($20 monthly) for up to 10 users.

item.name: Teamwork.com
item.operatingSystem: Web; iOS and Android apps; desktop apps listed on every plan.
item.description: Project management for agencies and client-service teams: tasks, Gantt and boards plus time tracking, budgets, invoicing and resource planning.

offers.description: Basics, per user per month billed annually, minimum 3 users; monthly billing costs about 29% more by the vendor’s own figure, but the monthly rate is not printed in the page text.

item.name: YouTrack
item.operatingSystem: Web, YouTrack Mobile for iOS and Android, and YouTrack Server for self-hosting.
item.description: Issue tracker and project tool with agile boards, Gantt charts, timesheets, a knowledge base and helpdesk; sold as Cloud or self-hosted Server.

offers.description: Cloud, per user per month on an annual plan ($54 a year) for teams above 10 users; $5.40 per user on a monthly plan, with volume discounts as teams grow. Prices from 1 October 2025.

item.name: Akiflow
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, Apple Watch and Wear OS. No Linux app.
item.description: A personal inbox and time-blocking planner that gathers tasks from email, chat and work tools and drags them onto your calendar.

offers.description: Pro, per person per month billed annually ($228 a year); $34 billed monthly. The annual card has carried a PROMO label since at least November 2025, but no other annual price is published and the FAQ quotes $19 without qualification. Local purchasing-power pricing may apply at checkout.

item.name: Businessmap
item.operatingSystem: Web, plus iOS and Android apps listed as “Businessmap formerly Kanbanize” (App Store and Google Play, both last updated in January 2026).
item.description: Kanban-based portfolio and work management: boards, initiatives, OKRs, Gantt-style planning and flow analytics, sold as one plan with a 15-seat entry.

offers.description: Standard, per user per month billed annually at the 15-user entry tier ($1,896 a year); $12.70 billed monthly; the rate falls to $8.50 annually at 100 users.

item.name: Celoxis
item.operatingSystem: Web; iOS and Android apps for task updates, time logging and approvals.
item.description: Project portfolio management for PMOs: scheduled Gantt plans, resource capacity, timesheets, costing and billing, in the cloud or on-premise.

offers.description: Core, per full-access user per month billed annually, minimum 5 users; timesheets are a $5 add-on on Core. No monthly-billing price is published.

item.name: Favro
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, and desktop apps for macOS and Windows.
item.description: Agile planning tool where the same cards live on Kanban boards, sheets, roadmaps and backlogs across teams; no free plan.

offers.description: Lite, per user per month billed annually; $6 billed monthly. Sold in team-size buckets of 2, 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100 users, so a 3-person team pays for 5.

item.name: Fibery
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS and Windows desktop apps, iOS and Android apps (released 2026), and Chrome and Firefox extensions.
item.description: No-code work platform where teams build their own linked databases, with docs, whiteboards, ten views, automations and AI on top.

offers.description: Standard, per user per month billed annually; $15 billed monthly. Observers and guests are free.

item.name: Freedcamp
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, Windows and macOS desktop apps, plus a separate Freedcamp Chat app for iOS and Android.
item.description: Project workspace of tasks, Kanban, calendar, time, files and discussions, with Gantt, wiki, CRM and invoices on paid tiers.

offers.description: Pro, per user per month billed annually; $2.49 billed monthly. Read-only and guest collaborators are free on paid plans.

item.name: Nifty
item.operatingSystem: Web; desktop apps for macOS and Windows; iOS and Android apps; Chrome extension.
item.description: Project workspace combining milestone roadmaps (Gantt), tasks, docs, files, chat and time tracking, sold per member or as flat team bundles.

offers.description: Pro per-member plan, per member per month billed annually ($16 billed monthly); teams of seven or more can instead pay a flat $79 a month billed annually for Pro with 10 members.

item.name: Nozbe
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, iPadOS, Android, macOS and Windows.
item.description: Task manager for small teams built around projects, task comments and a personal priority list. List and calendar views only. EU-hosted.

offers.description: Premium, per user per month billed annually ($108 a year for one user); $11 billed monthly. Prices are set by team size and fall to $8 per user from 10 users.

item.name: OmniFocus
item.operatingSystem: macOS, iOS, iPadOS, watchOS and visionOS apps, plus OmniFocus for the Web in a desktop browser (designed for computers rather than phones). No native Windows, Linux or Android apps.
item.description: A Getting Things Done task manager for Apple devices, with projects, tags, defer dates and perspectives; the web app is a paid companion.

offers.description: OmniFocus Subscription at $99.99 a year ($8.33 a month), covering the Pro apps on every Apple device plus OmniFocus for the Web: the cheapest route to the web app without first buying a licence. Sold annually on Omni’s store; the App Store lists its $9.99 monthly and $99.99 yearly subscriptions as legacy. Owners of a perpetual licence can add web access for $49.99 a year or $4.99 a month.

item.name: Paymo
item.operatingSystem: Web; Paymo Track desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux; iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Work management for small agencies and freelancers: tasks, time tracking, invoicing and, on the top plan, Gantt charts and team scheduling.

offers.description: Solo (one user, up to 3 clients and 5 projects), per month billed annually; $9.90 billed monthly. The team plans start with Plus at $10.90 per user billed annually.

item.name: Plaky
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and Android.
item.description: Board-based work tracker with table, Kanban, Gantt and chart views, sold by the makers of Clockify. Free for unlimited users.

offers.description: Pro, per seat per month billed annually; $4.99 billed monthly. No seat minimum; up to 5 free Viewers per paid seat.

item.name: Productive

item.description: Agency operations platform: projects and tasks tied to budgets, time tracking, resource planning, invoicing and a sales pipeline.

offers.description: Essential, per user per month billed annually; $12 billed monthly; minimum 3 seats.

item.name: Quire
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android (Play Store or APK), a Quire Desktop app, a Chrome extension, and Gmail and Outlook add-ins.
item.description: Infinitely nested task lists with Kanban, timeline, calendar, table and dashboard views over the same tree.

offers.description: Professional, per member per month billed annually; $10.95 billed monthly. External team members count as paid members.

item.name: Redbooth
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and Android, plus a Chrome extension and Gmail and Outlook add-ins.
item.description: Team task manager with workspaces, Kanban boards, a Gantt timeline, a team calendar and Zoom calls inside tasks. Free for two users.

offers.description: Pro, per user per month billed annually; $12 billed monthly. No seat minimum is stated.

item.name: Shortcut
item.operatingSystem: Web application. No Shortcut app turned up in an Apple App Store search in November 2026, and neither the help centre nor the pricing page documents a mobile or desktop app; the iOS app announced in 2019 appears to be gone.
item.description: Agile tracker for product and engineering teams: stories, epics, iterations and objectives on Kanban boards, with docs and reports built in.

offers.description: Team, per user per month billed annually; $10 billed monthly.

item.name: Sunsama
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android; the mobile apps are companions to the desktop planner.
item.description: A daily planner that pulls tasks from email, calendars and work tools into a day-by-day board, with timeboxing on your real calendar.

offers.description: Pro, per person per month billed annually ($204 a year); $22 billed monthly. Each teammate in a shared workspace costs the same.

item.name: Superlist
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS, iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android; Windows users rely on the web app.
item.description: A to-do list app from the Wunderlist team: lists that double as documents, shared with others, with AI voice capture and meeting notes.

offers.description: Basic, per person per month billed annually ($59 a year); $6 billed monthly. Teams pay the same rate per member.

item.operatingSystem: Web on Mac and PC; iOS and Android apps.
item.description: Drag-and-drop Gantt scheduling for small teams and builders, priced per account and per project rather than per seat.

offers.description: The single Teamhood plan, per user per month billed annually (€11); $16 (€14) billed monthly, excluding VAT, with a 3-licence minimum and guests counted as licences.

item.name: Toodledo
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and Android apps, desktop apps, and dozens of third-party clients listed in the vendor’s directory.
item.description: Dense, long-running task manager with folders, contexts, goals and custom columns, plus notes, outlines, lists, habits and a per-task timer.

offers.description: Standard, per person per month billed annually; $4.99 billed monthly. Plus is $5.99 billed annually or $7.99 monthly; Business is quote-only.

item.name: Tweek
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS and iPadOS, Android, and a native Mac app (November 2026).
item.description: A minimal weekly planner that lays out to-dos like a paper diary, one column per day, with shared calendars and optional calendar sync.

offers.description: Premium Individual, per person per month billed annually ($49.99 a year); $5.99 billed monthly. Family covers five people for $89.99 a year or $9.99 a month.

item.name: Workflowy

item.description: An infinitely nested bullet outline used for notes and to-dos, with any branch viewable as a board, table or dated calendar entry.

offers.description: Pro, per person per month billed annually; $8.99 billed monthly. Teams pay $6.99 per user per month billed annually.

item.name: Workzone
item.operatingSystem: Web, with a mobile-optimised browser interface for iOS and Android; no native apps.
item.description: Project management for marketing, creative and operations teams, with Gantt, boards, intake requests, proofing and bundled human training.

offers.description: Starter, per user per month, billed annually only (no monthly option), for 1 to 25 users; Team is $20 with a 5-user minimum.

item.name: Zenkit Projects
item.operatingSystem: Web, iOS, Android, and desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux.
item.description: Database-style project tool with table, Kanban, list, calendar, Gantt, mind map and wiki views over the same items. Hosted in Germany.

offers.description: Plus, per seat per month billed annually ($9 monthly, also €8 and €9), excluding VAT, capped at 10 users; Team at $12 ($14) is the first plan without a user cap.

item.name: Amazing Marvin
item.operatingSystem: Web, macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, Apple Watch and a browser extension.
item.description: A single-user task manager and day planner built from switchable ‘strategies’, aimed at procrastinators and people with ADHD.

offers.description: Marvin Pro, per person per month billed annually ($96 a year); $12 billed monthly. 50% student discount and ‘pay what you can’ on request.

item.name: Todoi
item.operatingSystem: Web only; no native apps.
item.description: A small, free task manager that opens ready to use in a browser tab: each project seen as a list, a board and a calendar, with no account.

offers.description: No paid tier: the whole app is free, with no account, trial or seat count.

@graph.name: todoi.org commercial task manager dataset
@graph.description: 58 commercial, closed-source task managers sold as a service: pricing, audience, five capability checks, six scored criteria with written reasoning, and sources.

mainEntity.name: Why does a directory of open-source software list closed-source products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most people choosing a task manager are weighing a commercial service, and the open-source options are easier to judge against the market they compete with. This page applies the same method to fifty-eight of those services. No vendor pays to be listed, and there are no affiliate links. One product, Todoi, is built by this directory’s maintainer, and its record says so.

mainEntity.name: Why do two criteria differ from the open-source page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ease of deployment means little for a service someone else runs, so Value for money takes its place. Data sovereignty becomes Data control: without the source, the questions are where the data lives, which certifications back that up, whether a self-managed edition exists, and what AI features do with your content.

The Paid from column is the cheapest paid plan per user per month, billed annually, in US dollars as published around 10 November 2026. Monthly billing almost always costs more; each record gives both where the vendor publishes both. A flat team price is shown as what each of ten people would pay, a price in euros is converted, and both carry a ≈ with the published price beneath; a dagger marks a seat minimum or another qualification. The cheapest plan is rarely the one a growing team ends up on, and the record says which tier the limits push you towards.

mainEntity.name: Does a free plan mean free?

acceptedAnswer.text: It means a permanent tier with no time limit. Most cap seats, projects, storage, automations or history, and each record says where. A free trial is not a free plan, and the filter does not count one.

mainEntity.name: Are all fifty-eight assessed to the same depth?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every record carries a Confidence value. Each product was researched from the vendor’s own pricing, documentation and trust pages, checked against the live pages by a second reader, then edited against the rest of the set so that a 4 means the same thing in every row. Where a fact rests on a secondary source, the record says so.

Compiled on 11 November 2026. Commercial prices and plans change several times a year, far more often than open-source licences do, so check the vendor’s own page before you buy. Each record’s caveat names what was changing when it was written.
